theater: 佩滕北部帕西翁河流域

battle.name: 第十二次「星際大戰」
battle.theater: 佩滕北部帕西翁河流域
battle.brief: 公元735年12月1日，佩滕北部帕西翁河流域，塞伊瓦爾城邦在石灰岩台地上被多斯皮拉斯聯軍攻破，國主被擒、舊碑盡毀，戰爭列表記為第十二次「星際大戰」。卡面的秦弩屬東亞兵器，從未出現在瑪雅戰場；位置上相應的，是塞伊瓦爾守軍以擲矛器與弓箭把進攻者壓在坡下。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場戰爭在公元735年12月1日爆發，戰場是瑪雅古典期北佩滕的帕西翁河流域，即今瓜地馬拉佩滕省薩亞克切以東約十六公里的塞伊瓦爾（Seibal，舊作 El Ceibal）城址。交戰一方是佩滕貝邦王國（Petexbatun），其都城多斯皮拉斯建於公元六二九年左右，是這段時期帕西翁兩岸的新興霸權，國王以多斯皮拉斯新建的宮殿群與神廟群維持正統，軍隊以佩滕貝邦的常備步兵為骨幹，配屬多斯皮拉斯本地的虎紋精英戰士與投射兵，並得到盟友卡拉科爾的遠程支援。另一方是塞伊瓦爾，帕西翁河沿岸規模最大的城邦，踞高出河面約一百米的石灰岩台地，核心區建築密度每平方公里約四百三十六座，居民以玉米農耕與河流交通為生，守軍是台地上的民兵投射手、持矛突擊隊與獵豹紋圓盾兵。第三方包括已被多斯皮拉斯連年削弱、其君主正淪為俘虜的蒂卡爾，與多斯皮拉斯聯盟的卡拉科爾及烏克斯特佩通，以及保持觀望的帕倫凱與科潘等城邦；它們未必直接參戰，卻全被捲入佩滕北部權力重心的轉移。
countriesEn: This war broke out on 1 December AD 735, in the Pasión River valley of northern Petén, that is, at the site of Seibal (El Ceibal), about sixteen kilometres east of the modern town of Sayaxché in the Petén Department of Guatemala. One side was the Petexbatun kingdom, whose capital at Dos Pilas had been founded around AD 629 and had become the rising hegemon of the Pasión valley. Its king held court in a newly built palace group and temple precinct at Dos Pilas, and its army rested on the standing infantry of the Petexbatun, reinforced by local jaguar-pelt elites and missile troops from Dos Pilas itself, with long-range support generally attributed to the allied forces of Caracol, whose archers and dart throwers operated across the field. The other side was Seibal, the largest polity of the Pasión river region, perched on a limestone bluff roughly a hundred metres above the river, with an average of about four hundred and thirty-six structures per square kilometre in its core, and a population living on maize agriculture and river traffic; its defenders were the missile-armed militia of the bluff top, thrusting spear units and jaguar-skin round-shield infantry. Third parties included Tikal, worn down by Dos Pilas year after year and whose king was itself in captivity, the allied city-states of Caracol and Uaxactun, and such observers as Palenque and Copán. They did not necessarily fight in this battle, yet all of them were drawn into the shift of power in northern Petén.
people: 主戰一方的多斯皮拉斯國王是葉什·努恩·阿欣一世（Yax Nuun Ahiin I，綽號葉片美洲虎），一般認為即公元六二九年把蒂卡爾王系帶到佩滕貝邦、建立多斯皮拉斯的那位君主；他年輕時在蒂卡爾即位，公元六九二年其父西雅赫·錢·卡維爾二世在多斯皮拉斯遇害後，他出走另立門戶，並與卡拉科爾結盟，反過來攻打蒂卡爾。另一關鍵人物是卡拉科爾之王卡爾圖恩·希什·卡維爾一世（K'altuun Hix K'awiil I），多斯皮拉斯的盟主，其九號碑於公元七三六年豎立，記錄對蒂卡爾的戰果，是本戰役最重要的同時代旁證。蒂卡爾方面，此時在位的是查克·托克·伊查克一世（Chak Tok Ich'aak I），他正是在多斯皮拉斯與卡拉科爾連年進攻中覆國被擒的君主，蒂卡爾三十一號碑於公元七四三年補記這段敗績。塞伊瓦爾方面的關鍵人物是它的國王與守軍統帥：一役之後，國王與宮室成員被帶往多斯皮拉斯，其名字多見於殘碑與後世抄本；塞伊瓦爾十一號碑的年代學界多置於七三五年前後，為這位君主而立的可能性很高，確切對讀仍有爭議。
peopleEn: The king of the main attacking side, Dos Pilas, was Yax Nuun Ahiin I, known as the Foliated Jaguar, generally identified with the ruler who carried the Tikal royal line into the Petexbatun and founded Dos Pilas around AD 629. He had taken the throne at Tikal while still young, and after his father Siyaj Chan K'awiil II was killed at Dos Pilas in AD 692 he left to found his own city, allied himself with Caracol and turned back against Tikal. The other key figure was K'altuun Hix K'awiil I, king of Caracol and Dos Pilas's sponsor; his Stela 9, dedicated in AD 736, records his successes against Tikal and is the most important contemporary cross-check on this campaign. On the Tikal side the ruler at the time was Chak Tok Ich'aak I, the king whose state was overturned and who was taken captive during the renewed offensives of Dos Pilas and Caracol; Tikal's Stela 31, raised in AD 743, later recorded that defeat. On the Seibal side the key figures were its king and the commander of its defence. After the fighting the king and the members of his household were carried off to Dos Pilas, and his name survives in fragmentary inscriptions and later copies. The date of Seibal's Stela 11 is generally placed around AD 735, so it was probably raised for this ruler, although the exact reading remains debated.
kits: 卡面兵器是秦弩，即中國的儲能式弩機，出土與傳世年代集中在戰國至漢代，早於本役數百年已在北方邊防與楚秦戰場上服役，憑一扣一放的連續動作，把守城一方從容的射速壓在進攻者身上。但秦弩屬東亞體系，從未出現在中美洲，與塞伊瓦爾、多斯皮拉斯的實戰全不相干；在功能上與它最接近的，是瑪雅人手中的擲矛器：同樣以槓桿把臂肩之力存進器具末端，脫手時把投射物送得更平更遠，其次才是弓與箭。石英與黑曜石製作的矛頭、箭鏃貼在木杆上，擲矛器是木製的投槓，此外還有短柄石斧式的黑曜石手斧、嵌刃木棒，以及古典期常見的直推長矛。進攻方在坡下成列投射，防守方在台地邊緣居高回擊，這正是弩與擲矛器在守城戰裡的共同位置。裝備來源也分散：黑曜石來自西部火山高地，棉布與鹽自低地與海岸運入，玉米與可可粉負擔糧秣，河道靠獨木舟運輸，谷地陸路由徒步縱隊擔負。
kitsEn: The card weapon is the Chinese crossbow, the stored-tension trigger mechanism of China, archaeologically attested from the Warring States through the Han and in service on the northern frontier fortifications and the Chu–Qin fronts long before this battle. It was the repeated cock-and-release action that gave the defenders their rate of fire against men coming up to the walls. The crossbow, however, belongs to an East Asian system and never reached Mesoamerica; it had no part whatever in the fighting at Seibal or Dos Pilas. The closest functional equivalent in the hands of the Maya was the atlatl, which likewise used a lever to store the force of arm and shoulder and released the projectile on a flatter and longer trajectory, with the bow and arrow following after it. Obsidian and chert points were hafted to wooden shafts, the atlatl was a wooden throwing board, and there were also obsidian hand axes, blades set in clubs, and the thrusting spears common to the Classic period. The attackers fired in massed lines from below the slope while the defenders answered from the rim of the bluff: that is the shared position of crossbow and atlatl in a siege. Supply was dispersed as well. Obsidian came from the volcanic highlands to the west, cotton and salt travelled up from the lowlands and the coast, maize and cacao powder carried the rations, the rivers moved everything in dugout canoes, and the valley roads were worked by marching columns on foot.
tactics: 瑪雅人沒有留下戰術手冊，可循的只有碑銘、彩繪器物與地表的痕跡；從塞伊瓦爾的地形與殘跡看，七三四年至七三五年的攻勢大致如此佈置：多斯皮拉斯聯軍沿帕西翁河谷的道路推進，抵達塞伊瓦爾台地之下，先以弓手與擲矛器在近距離對台地邊緣的防守射擊，同時在坡腳空地列陣，使防守方無法安全下地到平原；步兵再分批攀上石灰岩斜坡，突破台地邊緣的矮牆與樹林障礙。防守方以高度換取投射量數：從台地頂端的建築殘基與樹冠後方射擊，用石塊與投擲物覆蓋坡道，切斷進攻隊列，把對方拖成彼此失去支援的散兵。勝利之後，攻方系統性地破壞被征服者的紀念碑，砸損碑面、改刻或移走，用摧毀神聖時間的辦法宣示新秩序；首領與貴族被擒往都城，餘眾淪為附庸。星際大戰之名來自天文紀年：每一次大戰的日期都以長紀曆刻上石碑，統治者藉此說明自己在九巴頓週期裡的位置，而把戰爭排在卡特恩更替的前後，也就等於宣示新舊秩序的交替。
tacticsEn: The Maya left no manuals of tactics, only inscriptions, painted vessels and the traces in the ground. From the terrain of Seibal and from the surviving remains, the offensive of AD 734–735 can be reconstructed roughly as follows. The Dos Pilas coalition advanced along the valley road on the north side of the Pasión, reached the bluff below Seibal, and first brought archers and dart throwers up to close range against the defenders at the edge of the plateau, at the same time deploying in the open ground at the foot of the slope so that the defenders could not safely descend to the plain. The infantry then climbed the limestone incline in successive echelons, breaking through the low wall and the wooded obstacles at the rim of the bluff. The defenders traded height for volume of fire: they shot from behind the ruined buildings and the treetops at the top of the plateau, covered the ramps with stones and thrown debris, cut the attacking columns, and dragged the enemy into disconnected bands. After the victory the attackers systematically destroyed the monuments of the defeated, smashing the carved faces, recutting them or carrying them away, to announce a new order by annihilating the sacred calendar. The ruler and the nobility were taken to the capital and the population was reduced to vassalage. The name 'star war' comes from the astronomy: the date of each such war was carved in the Long Count on a stela, so that the ruler could show where in the cycle he stood, and to schedule a war around a katun turning point was to proclaim the replacement of one order by another.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但有幾項是碑銘與考古報告反覆引用的。交戰日期為公元七三五年十二月一日，瑪雅長紀曆記作 9.15.4.6.4，即第九巴克頓、第十五卡特恩、第四圖恩、第六烏伊納爾、第四金；勝者為多斯皮拉斯，敗者為塞伊瓦爾。塞伊瓦爾踞高出帕西翁河面約一百米的台地，距多斯皮拉斯約二十七公里、距蒂卡爾約一百公里、距現代薩亞克切約十六公里，核心區每平方公里平均分布四百三十六座建築，外圍為二百四十四座。塞伊瓦爾在八三〇至八九〇年的第二個高峰期，人口估計為八千至一萬人；七三五年時的常住人口沒有測量數字，碑銘與聚落殘跡都顯示城邑已處於收縮期。有紀錄的星際大戰共十三次，時間自公元五六二年至七八一年，本役是第十二次，也是距離下一次即第七八一年三月三十一日最近的一次。戰俘與損耗的數目沒有留下可信記載，雙方碑銘都不列戰損，只記勝負與慶典。
dataEn: Few figures can be checked, but several are cited again and again in the epigraphic and archaeological literature. The date of the battle is 1 December AD 735, recorded in the Maya Long Count as 9.15.4.6.4, that is nine baktuns, fifteen katuns, four tuns, six uinals and four kins, with Dos Pilas the winner and Seibal the loser. Seibal stood on a bluff about a hundred metres above the Pasión, twenty-seven kilometres from Dos Pilas, a hundred kilometres from Tikal and sixteen kilometres from the modern town of Sayaxché; the core zone carried an average of four hundred and thirty-six structures per square kilometre against two hundred and forty-four in the periphery. At Seibal's second peak, between AD 830 and 890, the estimated population was eight to ten thousand. There is no measured figure for the resident population in AD 735, and inscriptions and settlement traces alike show the town already in contraction. Thirteen star wars are recorded in all, running from AD 562 to AD 781; this is the twelfth of them, and the one closest in time to the next, 31 March AD 781. No trustworthy count of casualties or prisoners survives: the stelae on both sides note the date, the result and the celebration, and remain silent on the losses.
cause: 戰爭的起因是多斯皮拉斯的擴張與塞伊瓦爾的背離。佩滕貝邦王國自六二九年建都於多斯皮拉斯，四十年間靠佩滕貝邦的兵力與卡拉科爾的盟軍，先後在蒂卡爾與烏克斯特佩通一線得手，蒂卡爾在七三四至七三五年連遭重創，國王被擒，佩滕北部的權力真空一時洞開。多斯皮拉斯要在佩滕西部建立完整的勢力範圍，帕西翁河就是最直接的一條線，而位於河中游台地上的塞伊瓦爾曾倒向蒂卡爾陣營，在對多斯皮拉斯的戰爭中站在對方一邊，於是必須懲罰。曆法層面同樣有理由：長紀曆記到九巴頓十五卡特恩，新的卡特恩剛開始不久，統治者相信舊秩序的崩壞與新秩序的開始都集中在這樣的時段，於是為大規模用兵找到了紀年上的正統，也讓這場戰爭被記成一次星際大戰。
causeEn: The war grew out of Dos Pilas's expansion and Seibal's defection. Since Dos Pilas was founded in AD 629, the Petexbatun kingdom had spent forty years building on its own levies and on the allied armies of Caracol, gaining ground in turn against Tikal and Uaxactun. Tikal was badly hit in AD 734–735 and its king was taken captive, and a vacuum opened in northern Petén. To build a continuous sphere of control in western Petén, the Pasión was the most direct line, and Seibal, on its bluffs in the middle reaches, had thrown in its lot with Tikal and stood on the other side of the war against Dos Pilas. It therefore had to be punished. The calendar gave the same kind of warrant: the Long Count had reached the fifteenth katun of the ninth baktun, a new katun had only just begun, and rulers held that the collapse of the old order and the start of the new one were concentrated in such periods, so a great campaign could be given a legitimate place in the chronology, and this war was recorded as a star war.
impact: 塞伊瓦爾此後不再是獨立的城邦，而淪為佩滕貝邦的附庸，舊有的碑群在戰後被摧毀或改刻，直到公元八三〇年前後瓦圖爾·查特爾（Wat'ul Chatel）自東方烏卡納爾進入，帶來新的精英與新的建築期，塞伊瓦爾才重新站起來，於八三〇至八九〇年間出現第二個高峰，人口回到八千至一萬的量級。整個佩滕貝邦王國則在頂點之後迅速反轉：七三六年卡拉克穆爾介入，多斯皮拉斯與卡拉科爾的聯軍受挫；七四三年蒂卡爾三十一號碑記錄反攻；七四四年多斯皮拉斯方面的聯盟為蒂卡爾與烏克斯特佩通擊敗；到八世紀末，佩滕貝邦王國解體，多斯皮拉斯城址被放棄。更深一層的影響是制度性的：星際大戰被後世研究者視為古典期瑪雅的一次重置機制，勝者奪走年曆與廟宇的主導權，敗者以災難性的衰落告終，而被摧毀的碑面正是權力轉移最直觀的證據。
impactEn: Seibal ceased to be an independent polity and became a vassal of the Petexbatun, its old stelae smashed or recut, and it stayed in that condition until around AD 830, when Wat'ul Chatel arrived from Ucanal in the east with a new elite and a new building phase. Seibal rose again and enjoyed a second peak between AD 830 and 890, with a population back in the range of eight to ten thousand. The Petexbatun kingdom itself, at its summit, was turned over in quick succession: Calakmul intervened in AD 736 and the Dos Pilas–Caracol coalition was checked; Tikal's Stela 31 of AD 743 records the counter-attack; in AD 744 the Dos Pilas side was defeated by Tikal and Uaxactun; and by the end of the eighth century the Petexbatun kingdom had dissolved and Dos Pilas had been abandoned. The deeper consequence is institutional. The star war is read by later scholars as a reset mechanism of the Classic Maya, in which the victor takes over the calendar and the temples and the loser is left with catastrophic decline, with the shattered stelae as the most direct evidence of the transfer of power.
result: 結果是多斯皮拉斯在帕西翁河畔取得第十二次星際大戰的勝利：塞伊瓦爾的城防被突破，國王與貴族被俘往多斯皮拉斯，舊碑遭拆毀與改刻，塞伊瓦爾降為附庸，帕西翁河流域自此歸入佩滕貝邦的版圖。這一結果沒有留下可信的戰損數字，碑銘只記日期、勝負與慶典，不點戰俘與屍數；但可以確定的是，塞伊瓦爾此後數十年在考古紀錄上近乎消失，舊聚落不再豎立新碑。戰役的落點直接寫進了曆法：9.15.4.6.4 這一天，成為有紀錄星際大戰序列的第十二次；在此之前，佩滕北部的戰爭多半是城邦聯盟之間的反覆拉鋸，在此之後，多斯皮拉斯的霸權延續了約半個世紀，直到被卡拉克穆爾與蒂卡爾先後斬斷。
resultEn: The result was a Dos Pilas victory on the banks of the Pasión. Seibal's defences were breached, its king and nobility were carried off to Dos Pilas, the old stelae were torn down and recut, Seibal was reduced to a vassal, and the whole Pasión valley came under the Petexbatun's map. The outcome left behind no credible casualty figures: the inscriptions note only the date, the result and the celebration, and do not list the dead or the captives. What can be said with certainty is that Seibal nearly vanishes from the archaeological record for the following decades, with no new stelae raised in the old settlements. The outcome was written straight into the calendar. The day 9.15.4.6.4 became the twelfth of the recorded star wars; before it, the fighting in northern Petén had mostly been the back-and-forth of shifting city-state alliances, and after it, Dos Pilas's hegemony held for roughly half a century, until it was cut apart in turn by Calakmul and Tikal.
